component_content.title: Business Environment Analysis Module

content.title: Internal Factors
content.content: Business environment analysis involves identifying and analyzing internal factors that affect a company's operations. These factors can be categorized into two groups: macro-environmental and micro-environmental factors.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.

content.title: Macro-Environmental Factors
content.content: Macro-environmental factors are external to the organization itself. They include economic, technological, legal, demographic, and political factors.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.

content.title: Economic Factors
content.content: Economic factors are affected by the level of spending, inflation rate, interest rates, and currency exchange rates.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.

content.title: Technological Factors
content.content: Technological advancements are changing the way businesses operate. This includes digitalization, artificial intelligence, automation, and robotics.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.

content.title: Demographic Factors
content.content: Demographic factors include age, gender, income level, lifestyle, and family size.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.

content.title: Political Factors
content.content: Political stability, government policies, laws, regulations, and tax rates affect business operations.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.

content.title: Micro-Environmental Factors
content.content: Micro-environmental factors are directly related to the organization itself. These include customers, suppliers, competitors, employees, partners, and technology.
learning_objectives: LO 1.2: Identify and analyze internal and external factors influencing business operations.
